name: Taco Bar
notes: Three separate chalkboards: photo 1 (burritos/mulitas/ceviche/kids), photo 2 (plates/quesadillas/tortas/bowls/breakfast, drinks omitted), photo 3 (tacos, most legible prices). Burrito section lists ingredients but never prints prices, so price is omitted for those items; dropped 'Make it Wet' (a modifier) and the alcoholic drinks list (Micheladas, draft beer/beer) per the drink-only rule.
